title: 2007 AMC 10A Problem 1
statement: One ticket to a show costs \(\$20\) at full price. Susan buys \(4\) tickets using a coupon that gives her a \(25\%\) discount. Pam buys \(5\) tickets using a coupon that gives her a \(30\%\) discount. How many more dollars does Pam pay than Susan?

solutions.text:
Susan pays \(4 \cdot 0.75 \cdot 20 = 60\) dollars.

Pam pays \(5 \cdot 0.70 \cdot 20 = 70\) dollars.

The difference is \(70 - 60 = 10\) dollars.

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: A \(25\%\) discount means paying \(75\%\) of the full price
Compute each person’s total, then subtract
